claim: Disney's Le Roi Lion runs at Théâtre Mogador (Stage Entertainment France) from 17 December 2025 through summer 2026, extended to 9 August 2026.
quote: Du 17 décembre 2025 au 28 juin 2026, Le Roi Lion s'installe à nouveau dans ce temple des comédies musicales du 9ème arrondissement de Paris. L'aventure du Roi Lion se poursuit à Mogador jusqu'au 9 Août 2026!

claim: Le Roi Lion at Théâtre Mogador offers ticket categories Silver, 1, 2, plus VIP and VIP+, with prices including VAT and booking fees.
quote: various ticket categories including Silver, 1 and 2 plus VIP & VIP+ options ... the displayed ticket price includes VAT and reservation fees

claim: Les Misérables returns in a new French production by Ladislas Chollat at Théâtre du Châtelet from 11 November 2026 to 10 January 2027, tickets €53.90–€141.90, with French and English supertitles.
quote: Dates: November 11, 2026 – January 10, 2027 ... Ticket Prices: €53.90 – €141.90 ... new French production directed by Ladislas Chollat ... French and English supertitles

claim: The Théâtre du Châtelet 2025/2026 season features a new La Cage aux Folles with Laurent Lafitte (December), Kirill Serebrennikov's musical Hamlet opening, Sondheim's Company, and Offenbach's La Vie parisienne by the Comédie-Française in June.
quote: la création en décembre d'une nouvelle version de La Cage aux Folles avec Laurent Lafitte. Kirill Serebrennikov fera l'ouverture de la saison avec Hamlet dans une version musicale ... La Vie parisienne de Jacques Offenbach

claim: Monte-Cristo, le spectacle musical (Frank Wildhorn music) runs at Folies Bergère 5 February–19 April 2026 before a French tour.
quote: The musical will run from February 5, 2026 to April 19, 2026 ... compositions by Frank Wildhorn with texts by Jack Murphy ... begins its French tour at the Folies Bergère

claim: Folies Bergère also stages Shrek le Musical and A Second Before Christmas (from Romain Sardou's novel, 11 December 2026–17 January 2027) in 2026.
quote: A Second Before Christmas – The Musical, based on Romain Sardou's novel, will run from December 11, 2026, to January 17, 2027 ... Shrek le Musical will arrive at the Folies Bergère

claim: Paris offers English-accessible theatre via surtitles and smart glasses: Le Roi Lion at Mogador has English surtitles, and Comédie-Française classics (Molière, etc.) run in French with English surtitles Jan–Jul 2026.
quote: The Lion King at the Théâtre Mogador appeals to non-French-speaking audiences thanks to a system of English surtitles ... smart glasses for surtitling are available ... in English, French, and French Sign Language (LSF)

claim: Sting's The Last Ship plays at La Seine Musicale in English (with French surtitles) until 8 March 2026, marking the musical's first French engagement.
quote: The Last Ship continues at La Seine Musicale, Paris until 8 March 2026, and the English language performance (with French surtitles) marks the musical's first French engagement

claim: Mozart, l'Opéra Rock (1.4 million spectators in 2009–2011) is announced to return to the stage in 2026, revealed via the Le Roi Soleil revival programme.
quote: Mozart, l'Opéra Rock va donc faire son retour en 2026 sur scène ... attracted 1.4 million spectators between 2009-2011 ... announced through a full-page advertisement in the program for Le Roi Soleil

claim: Notre-Dame de Paris le spectacle ran at the Palais des Congrès de Paris from 19 December 2025 to 4 January 2026, tickets €38–€99, with no further 2026 Paris dates yet announced.
quote: performances ran from December 19, 2025 to January 4, 2026 at the Palais des Congrès de Paris ... Ticket Prices: €38 to €99 ... aucune date pour 2026 n'est encore annoncée

claim: Starmusical, a touring revue of major musical-comedy hits (Starmania, Les Dix Commandements, Mamma Mia, Mozart l'Opéra Rock, Roméo et Juliette, Priscilla), played the Dôme de Paris-Palais des Sports on 4–5 March 2026.
quote: Starmusical - Un Voyage au Cœur des Comédies Musicales took place at the Dôme de Paris - Palais des Sports on March 4 and 5, 2026 ... from Starmania to The Ten Commandments, including Mamma Mia, Mozart l'Opéra rock, Romeo and Juliet, and Priscilla

claim: Other 2026 Paris stage highlights include Les Demoiselles de Rochefort (Théâtre du Lido, extended to 14 June 2026, with live orchestra and English surtitles) and La Cenerentola at Palais Garnier (3 June–11 July 2026).
quote: Les Demoiselles de Rochefort ... Théâtre du Lido ... Extended through June 14, 2026 ... 36 performers on stage, with a live orchestra, vibrant sets, and English surtitles ... La Cenerentola ... Palais Garnier ... June 3 to July 11, 2026
